podcast.body: This initial recording was inspired by a line from the John Wayne film "The Searchers," which Holly and Joe Allison had seen multiple times. Owen Bradley, the producer, described it as "the worst song I've ever heard" due to Holly singing it in a high voice, following ill-advised counsel from Webb Pierce. This version was ultimately unreleased by Decca. "One of the songs that he recorded during that time, but which wasn't released, was one that Owen Bradley described as the worst song I've ever heard."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode Sixty-One: "That'll Be the Day", by the Crickets
